video_title: Rick Carlisle, Andrew Nembhard, Quenton Jackson & Larry Nance Jr. Media Availability | Oct. 19, 2026

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on Andrew Nembhard's versatility and role
quotes.excerpt: Expect him to be a versatile guy that can play both of those positions.
quotes.quote: He can play both positions. He played point well and he can play two. Expect him to be a versatile guy that can play both of those positions. At times he's even played some three when we've gone really, really small. He's still a young player but he has a pretty good amount of experience and he's ready for being a full-time roster guy and being ready at all times.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle says Andrew Nembhard is ready to be a full time roster guy and will be used in a versatile role playing both guard positions and even some small ball three.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on the challenge of playing New Orleans
quotes.excerpt: New Orleans presents a lot of difficult challenges with their high-level players.
quotes.quote: New Orleans presents a lot of difficult challenges with their high-level players, Zion and Murphy. They have young depth. Mathurin is a walking 15 and 5 guy, 16 and 5. He can really score. Pool is a great scorer. We don't know exactly who is going to start for them, but they have a lot of different ways they could go and we'll have to be ready. It's a very difficult game and their rebounding is a big, big problem.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle identifies rebounding as a major concern for the Pacers heading into their matchup against New Orleans, noting the Pelicans have a lot of different ways they can attack.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Nembhard
quotes.summary_phrase: Andrew Nembhard on the defensive impact of the new center
quotes.excerpt: The biggest thing that he helps us with is the defensive rebounds.
quotes.quote: We're just working on him getting up to touch. He's always been in a drop. I think the biggest thing that he helps us with is the defensive rebounds that end our defensive possessions but start our offense too.
quotes.social_post: Andrew Nembhard says the team is working on their new center getting up to touch rather than staying in a drop, emphasizing the importance of defensive rebounding to start their offense.

quotes.speaker: Quenton Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Quenton Jackson on his role as a second-unit point guard
quotes.excerpt: Get us in a flow, get us in offense, make sure everybody get touches.
quotes.quote: Get us in a flow, get us in offense, make sure everybody get touches and then make sure that energy is still on the floor and make sure we're picking up on defense too. I just try to come in and be an extension of TJ in some extent, that way we can keep the flow, keep the pace.
quotes.social_post: Quenton Jackson describes his role as a second unit point guard as being an extension of TJ McConnell to keep the flow and pace of the offense moving.

quotes.speaker: Larry Nance Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Larry Nance Jr. on the team's focus on process and speed
quotes.excerpt: This team is all about process and speed.
quotes.quote: This team is all about process and speed. I think that's something that really helped in my favor. Being in the league 12 years, playing with a bunch of different coaches, learning a bunch of different vocabularies, learning how to play. I think I've adjusted pretty well to the pace of the offense and I'm just excited to see it in action.
quotes.social_post: Larry Nance Jr. says he has adjusted well to the Pacers pace of play, noting that the team is all about process and speed.

quotes.speaker: Larry Nance Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Larry Nance Jr. on his positional versatility in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't say it's more so like specific team, but it's specific position.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't say it's more so like specific team, but it's specific position. When I got in the league I was drafted as an undersized power forward. Then a couple years later I'm starting at the three in Cleveland and then back to some five and some four and some five again. I think being able to move down the positions early in my career allowed that really helps with the decision-making process.
quotes.social_post: Larry Nance Jr. credits his early career experience playing multiple positions for helping his decision making process on the court.

quotes.speaker: Larry Nance Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Larry Nance Jr. on the Pacers' organizational culture
quotes.excerpt: A lot of places talk about culture, but this is a culture.
quotes.quote: A lot of places talk about culture, but this is a culture. These guys work hard, they are in here early on off days. It's really good for me to see, really good for other guys to see as well that are just getting here. I feel welcome, but they've done an awesome job, the front office, the coaching staff, the players of opening their arms and me, Kelly, and some of the new guys like really doing a good job of ingratiating us.
quotes.social_post: Larry Nance Jr. praises the Pacers organizational culture, saying the team puts in the work on off days and has done a great job welcoming new players.
